Robot01.strDesc:
A mainstay in off-world construction projects, Beydat drones are tireless laborers capable of precision work, without any of the overhead costs associated with wages or occupational safety and health compliance.

They are, however, saddled with a reputation as being extremely easy to damage. Something often exploited for sport by humans whom the drones replace.

Robot02.strDesc:
Developed as something of a reaction to "Weaver" drones being vandalized all the time, Beydat sought to broaden the scope of their automated worker offering.

By redesigning the chassis to accommodate more weight, replacing fragile legs with tread housings, adding armor and a weapons platform, and tacking "Security" onto the drone's operating purview, Beydat has succeeded in creating a drone loathed to an even greater degree.

ItmAntiGravPen01.strDesc:
This Van Buren-engineered injection offers a short-term boost to high-G tolerance, delivered through a single-use subcutaneous injector pen that works through clothes and thin spacesuits.

The medication primarily works to maintain adequate cardiac output and alertness to reduce G-LOC and injury under high-G strain.

Liability labels assert the drug is most effective in healthier bodies, but proprietary additives Adrenolux and Hemofoam claim to provide even micro-G adapted bodies some protection, with acceptable levels of post-exposure side effects.

ItmAntiHypoVPen01.strDesc: This Brave New World-engineered experimental injection is intended to reduce the symptoms of micro-G hypovolemia for about 72 hours, and permanently after 5 doses, delivered through a single-use subcutaneous injector pen that works through clothes and thin spacesuits. Improves circulatory capacity and kidney and spleen function by encouraging cell growth in blood vessels and organs.

ItmAntiRadPen01.strDesc:
This Van Buren-engineered injection intended to reduce wide spectrum radiation in a living body, delivered through a single-use subcutaneous injector pen that works through clothes and thin spacesuits.

The medication is comprised of a cocktail of Prussian Blue (potassium ferric hexacyanoferrate) and DTPA (Diethylenetriamine pentaacetic acid) binding agents for bodily elimination, potassium iodide for thyroid protection, and the proprietary ChymAdd stem cell stabilizer for high energy exposures.

Typically used daily after radiation exposure. Not effective against cancer and hair loss.

ItmCargoVolatiles01.strDesc:

ItmSignalBeacon01.strDesc:

The beacon is based on two modules, namely the power module and the broadcast module, that contain all necessary components for long-term autonomy.

In order to increase the overall system reliability, redundancy is implemented for both primary subsystems.

ItmTransponder01Off.strDesc:
The legal face and heart of a ship, a transponder (XPDR) transmits identifying signals to other ships, and differentiates friends from foes. Penalties are steep for civilian craft failing to maintain a single active transponder identifying the vessel. This is in part due to the danger of collisions with other vessels, but also since pirates often "fly dark" to avoid notice.

Extremely prone to damage from uninstalling or tampering. Ship must also have a powered 1090MHz antenna installed separately.

This one is styled 'Acceptable Algae'. It's not just good, It's 'Acceptable'.

The Future Foods Trencher (tm) is a space food staple renowned for its long life and unique flavour. The packaging is a biosolid which is just as technically edible as the contents. 'Trenchers: The joy of eating... replaced by the necessity of sustenance.'

This one is styled 'Chipotle Pork with Cheese Spread'. 3 out of 5 taste-testers agree this is what pork and cheese was described as tasting like in an Old Earth book.
ItmTrencherChipotlePorkCheeseSpread.strNameFriendly: Food: Trenchers Chipotle Pork with Cheese Spread

ItmTrencherKungPaoChicken.strDesc:
The Future Foods Trencher (tm) is a space food staple renowned for its long life and unique flavour. The packaging is a biosolid which is just as technically edible as the contents.

This one is styled 'Kung Pao Chicken', though it couldn't be further from either of those things.

ItmTrencherMysteryMeatInSurpriseSauce.strNameFriendly: Food: Trenchers Mystery Meat in Surprise Sauce

ItmTrencherNachoFiesta.strDesc:

ItmTrencherPizzaPouch.strDesc:
The Future Foods Trencher (tm) is a space food staple renowned for its long life and unique flavour. The packaging is a biosolid which is just as technically edible as the contents. 'Trenchers: Almost too easy.'

This one is styled 'Pizza Pouch', a disheartening attempt at encapsulating the Old Earth classic into a space-friendly format. The imitation pineapple doesn't help.

ItmTrencherSpicyBuffaloWings.strDesc:

ItmFoodHot01.strDesc:
"Peppercorn" is a misnomer, of course, being a meticulously dried berry of the prickly ash tree.

Most famous for its málà flavor profile combining a tingling sensation with spicy numbness, this mystical flavor experience is a decadent, welcomed Hangzhou export.
ItmFoodHot01.strNameFriendly: Street Food: Szechuan Beef with Pink Peppercorn

ItmFoodHot02.strDesc:
Nigerian-style pepper soup is a spice-forward dish supporting nearly any protein (in this case textured algae).

The spice mix may vary, but the aromatic power comes from roasting the seeds before crushing them.
ItmFoodHot02.strNameFriendly: Street Food: Algae Broth in a Bag with Alligator Pepper and Seared Tomatoes

ItmFoodHot03.strDesc:
Carbon fiber suya skewers of protein morsels bathed in a classic peanut-based, smoky spice rub.

They're most definitely not chicken, but the best vendors can be surprisingly convincing.
ItmFoodHot03.strNameFriendly: Street Food: Kebab of Chicken in a Yaji Spice Rub

ItmFoodHot04.strDesc: Hot and delicious spot prawn stir fry in suya curry, wrapped in translucent, edible biosolid foil for convenient carrying and disposal.
ItmFoodHot04.strNameFriendly: Street Food: Spot Prawn Curry Stir Fry

ItmFoodHot05.strDesc:
Nothing beats good noodles, except maybe noodles made from single cell protein and mealworm powder topped with a dash of Nestégg's famous Herb-and-Dairy Flakes.

Nestégg vehemently disapproves of such a pedestrian use of its flavoring, but that has only reinforced the practice.
ItmFoodHot05.strNameFriendly: Street Food: Entomoprotein Noodles with Nestégg Herb-and-Dairy Flakes

ItmFoodHot06.strDesc:
These flour-like powder balls rolled with fish-flavored flakes are fried and often smothered in your choice of sweet, sour, spicy, or a mix of sauces.

The chili vinegar sauce is a particular favorite among K-Leg's shipbreakers.
ItmFoodHot06.strNameFriendly: Street Food: Chili Vinegar Fish Balls

A kiosk offering retail sales of ship equipment and niceities for the discerning spacer: Furniture, lighting, decor, consumer electronics, storage solutions, and more.

In the void, life support may keep your body alive, but it's lifestyle goods that let you live.

ItmKioskHealth01.strDesc: A kiosk operated by Van Buren Pharmaceuticals offering medical supplies (acute and preventative), surgical or pharmaceutical treatment of scars and some chronic ailments, and outpatient treatments such as nanorobotic first aid to assist general healing.

ItmKioskJobs02.strDesc: A work distribution platform managed by Agile Workforce Solutions. Jobs are posted by verified employers and then priced according to a proprietary algorithm. Freelancers pay costs up front to accept a gig.

ItmKioskJobs03.strDesc: A work distribution platform managed by Agile Workforce Solutions. Jobs are posted by verified employers and then priced according to a proprietary algorithm. Freelancers pay costs up front to accept a gig.

ItmKioskOKLGFoodCart01.strDesc:
A semi-automated provider of fresh-prepared meals that nourish your soul as much or more than your belly.

This cart claims to offer the vibrant Martian flavors of Xinhua to spacers who may never know Martian gravity.

ItmKioskOKLGFoodCart02.strDesc:
A semi-automated provider of fresh-prepared meals that nourish your soul as much or more than your belly.

This cart claims to provide the Nigerian flavor profiles and unique spice mixes popularized decades ago by the Ogiso space elevator on old Earth and more recently by K-Leg's infamous asteroid colony and ship graveyard.

ItmKioskOKLGShipBroker01.strDesc: A kiosk operated by Ogiso's Registry and Ogiso Bank allowing clients to buy and sell spacecraft, view spacecraft ratings, and replacement transponders for legally registered vessels. Alternate kiosk functions are available to the right and left of the main access panel.

ItmKioskResBroker01VENC.strDesc: A kiosk operated by real estate corporations and local landlords, allowing clients with legal status to buy and sell residential spaces. Permanent residency or citizenship required.

ItmKioskVORBScrap01.strDesc:
A kiosk operated by Venus Reclamation Corp, allowing visiting haulers to buy and sell any salvage and wares.

Venus always has a steady demand for hull parts, scrap materials, replacement components, used cargo pods, and anything else a visiting ship can spare.

ItmKioskSupplies01.strDesc: A kiosk operated by Ayotimiwa Corp. offering an array of small-scale essentials to bolster the productivity of shipbreakers and visiting traders. On offer are maintenance tools, provisions, cargo dollies, replacement spacesuits, hull patches, clothing, and other basics of work and survival.

ItmKioskSupplies02.strDesc:
A kiosk operated by Ayotimiwa Corp. allowing shipbreakers to buy and sell any low-value salvage and wares.

Watchful pickers can find a steady supply of hull segments from various manufacturers stocked daily, as well as scrap metals, specialty replacement components, and the actual nuts and bolts of ship work.

To sell high-value parts, visit the License Kiosk nearby.

ItmKioskSupplies03.strDesc: Owned and operated by the Ayotimiwa Corporation, this kiosk will buy high value salvage obtained in local space. Requires a temporary license, which can also be purchased at this kiosk.

ItmKioskGovt01.strDesc: A kiosk operated by local corporations offering an array of small-scale essentials to bolster the productivity of laborers, spacers, and visiting traders. On offer are maintenance tools, provisions, cargo dollies, replacement spacesuits, hull patches, clothing, and other basics of work and survival.

ItmKioskTransit01.strDesc: Owned and operated by the local corporation to serve the bustling colony's needs, this kiosk allows unlimited, free access to any connected locations currently available.

ItmLeggings01.strDesc:
Lightweight, body-hugging compression pants that can be worn under space suits.

A staple garment for those expecting high-G maneuevers, this design provides slight resistance to G-LOC and strain by preventing blood pooling in the lower extremities while under high-Gs.

ItmLeggings02.strDesc:
Lightweight, body-hugging pants that can be worn under space suits.

A staple spacer garment, this pair includes a small pocket and expressive designs (but no anti-G benefits).

ItmFilterCO201.strDesc: A LiOH cartridge designed for use in shipboard atmosphere scrubbers for life support. In an exothermic reaction, LiOH bonds with CO2 from the air to produce lithium carbonate and H2O. Ships require about one cartridge per day for each crew member.

ItmFilterCO201Dmg.strDesc: A LiOH cartridge designed for use in shipboard atmosphere scrubbers for life support. In an exothermic reaction, LiOH bonds with CO2 from the air to produce lithium carbonate and H2O. Ships require about one cartridge per day for each crew member.

ItmComponentMotor01.strDesc: These variable frequency drive induction motors are commonly used to repair equipment that is damaged. They have a standardized mounting pattern cast as an integral part of the motor shell.

ItmHeatSink01.strDesc: These passive heat exchangers are commonly used to repair damaged equipment that requires significant temperature regulation. Typically made from aluminum or copper, they have a standardized mounting pattern cast as an integral part of the protrusion body.

ItmComponentMobo01.strDesc: A printed circuitboard used in computers and other devices requiring more complex logic circuitry. While variations exist between manufacturers, almost all motherboards come with a standard set of integrated peripherals for controlling processing, I/O, and other functions, and fit an industry-standard form factor.

ItmOssifexPen01.strDesc:
'Osteoclasts are a thing of the past!' This Van Buren-engineered cocktail of bioactive peptides, growth factors, and tailored nanoparticles stimulates both osteoblast activity and protein synthesis and mitochondrial function (to counter atrophy from zero-g living), delivered through a single-use subcutaneous injector pen that works through clothes and thin spacesuits.

One use per day keeps the atrophy away, replacing the need for dedicated daily exercise.

ItmOxygenCandle01.strDesc: An emergency, single-use device that, once activated by a spring-actuated hammer, chemically generates oxygen from Lithium perchlorate (LiClO4). Most effective in small, stable compartments.

ItmOxygenCandle01On.strDesc: An emergency, single-use device that, once activated by a spring-actuated hammer, chemically generates oxygen from Lithium perchlorate (LiClO4), with an added light for a comforting cosmetic effect. Most effective in small, stable compartments.

ItmPants01.strDesc: Once a definitive garment of the laborer, and later a staple of casual wear, these denim trousers are now something of a luxury item off-Earth.

ItmPantsCargoStrapped01.strDesc: Roomy pants with bonus pockets and harness straps.

ItmPartsElecSmall01.strDesc:
A varied collection of parts essential to repairing most powered equipment, including wires, resisters, fuses, LEDs, diodes, and similar.

Prone to fall through cracks, they store well in pouches or small containers.

ItmPartsMechSmall01.strDesc:
A varied collection of parts essential to repairing most equipment, including nuts, bolts, springs, gears, tubes, tape, and similar.

Prone to fall through cracks, they store well in pouches or small containers.

ItmPartsScreen01.strDesc: A display screen used in repairing damaged equipment. Designed to be temperature resistant and high light-transmittance for use in space applications.

ItmPillBottle02.strDesc: A prescription pain reliever in pill format. Rated "most likely to be stolen from a party host's medicine cabinet" by OWNG's "Redline" news program.

ItmToolDrill01.strDesc: A Gott handheld power drill with torque compensator, necessary to install most shipboard components.

ItmToolDrill01Dmg.strDesc: A damaged Gott handheld power drill with torque compensator, necessary to install most shipboard components.

ItmToolFireEx01.strDesc:
An Halvorson Class C portable fire extinguisher, rated for most shipboard emergencies.

Suitable as a bludgeoning tool in some scenarios.

ItmToolFireEx01Dmg.strDesc:
An Halvorson Class C portable fire extinguisher, rated for most shipboard emergencies.

Suitable as a bludgeoning tool in some scenarios.

ItmToolGrinder02.strDesc: A Gott handheld angle grinder, a cheap way to uninstall ship parts, when powered.

ItmToolGrinder02Dmg.strDesc: A damaged Gott handheld angle grinder, a cheap way to uninstall ship parts, when powered.

ItmToolHacksaw01.strDesc: A compact Horang-brand keyhole hacksaw. The barest minimum cutting tool necessary to uninstall hull structures and scrap most shipboard components.

ItmToolLaserTorch01.strDesc: A Weber high-intensity optical tool with adjustable power, focus, and wand attachment. Perfect for a range of jobs from soldering to cutting and welding, in any environment, when powered.

ItmToolLaserTorch01Dmg.strDesc: A Weber high-intensity optical tool with adjustable power, focus, and wand attachment. Perfect for a range of jobs from soldering to cutting and welding, in any environment, when powered.

ItmToolScrewDriver01.strDesc: A Horang handheld screwdriver, necessary to install most shipboard components.

ItmToolSolderingIron01.strDesc: A Gott handheld soldering iron, a cheap way to solder electronics.

ItmToolSolderingIron01Dmg.strDesc: A damaged Gott handheld soldering iron, a cheap way to solder electronics.

ItmToolWelder01.strDesc: A Halvorson handheld friction stir tool. Suitable for welding in pressurized and vacuum environments.

ItmToolWelder01Dmg.strDesc: A damaged Halvorson handheld friction stir tool. Suitable for welding in pressurized and vacuum environments.

ItmToolWorkLamp01.strDesc:
An ubiquitous Phoebus-brand industrial floodlight. Comes with magnetic grip feet.

Crucial to any would-be salvager.

ItmToolWorkLamp01On.strDesc:
An ubiquitous Phoebus-brand industrial floodlight. Comes with magnetic grip feet.

Crucial to any would-be salvager.

ItmToothbrush01.strDesc:
Testudo's AstroBristle Classic: "Spacers' choice for a cosmic clean that's out of this world!"

A proven tool that needs neither bells nor whistles, featuring nothing but good old, original AstroBristle engineering, colors, and packaging.

At least one hour of daily exercise is recommended for most spacers. FFWD Active Benefit: Exercise (Train Strong or remove Feeble).

ItmUbiqWISPNode01.strDesc:
Ubiq WISP telecom nodes act as miniature orbital or surface signal relays that self-organize into mesh networks when a critical mass share reasonable proximity.

Ubiq markets and deploys WISP clouds as a rapid, easy to maintain, and relatively inexpensive method of expanding telecom access in new areas.

ItmWallWindow1x1Loose.strDesc: Transparent aluminum panel wall. Aluminium oxynitride is a polycrystalline ceramic made from pressurized, heat-treated powder polished to an optical finish for decently sturdy material resistant to oxidation and radiation.

ItmWristPDA01.strDesc: A Renbao handheld smart PDA. A ubiquitous personal item that can be used to store contacts, manage crew and to do lists, take photos, etc. Will interface with most electronic subsystems, like ship navstations, or other personal computers.

ItmWristPDA01Locked.strDesc: A Renbao handheld smart PDA. A ubiquitous personal item that can be used to store contacts, manage crew and to do lists, take photos, etc. Will interface with most electronic subsystems, like ship navstations, or other personal computers.

ItmWristPDA01Dmg.strDesc: A Renbao handheld smart PDA. A ubiquitous personal item that can be used to store contacts, manage crew and to do lists, take photos, etc. Will interface with most electronic subsystems, like ship navstations, or other personal computers.

LiquidCoffee.strDesc: A 6 oz serving of rich Moretti Coffee, a space-adapted drink famous throughout The System. Often enjoyed from bulbs designed for zero-G drinking with proper aromatics. Not as hydrating as water, and prone to impose caffeine effects. Rich, dark, the way you like it. Have more. Have Moretti.

LiquidRiceWine.strDesc: A shot serving of one of Testudo Corp's diverse products, this fragrant rice wine is a bit of an in-joke with early shipbreakers. Passably useful for disinfecting wounds.

LiquidVodka.strDesc: A shot serving of Bismertnaya brand vodka, created by the Soyuzneft oil company. Made from wheat, this vodka was created when Soyuzneft began supplying it to the Russian Armed Forces in 2024. Useful for disinfecting wounds.

LiquidWater.strDesc:
A 1/4 L ration of life-giving water. What most of human bodies and humans' inaccessible homeworld is made of.

Humans need to drink at least 5 of these water units per day, more if exerting, sweaty, or ill.

OutfitEVA01.strDesc: A hermetically sealed suit capable of protecting the user from hard vacuum with its own onboard air rebreather and O2 tank. Even unpowered it's better than nothing, by about four layers of insulation.

OutfitEVA01Off.strDesc: A hermetically sealed suit capable of protecting the user from hard vacuum with its own onboard air rebreather and O2 tank. Even unpowered it's better than nothing, by about four layers of insulation.

OutfitEVA01Dmg.strDesc: A damaged hermetically sealed suit capable of protecting the user from hard vacuum with its own onboard air rebreather and O2 tank. Even unpowered it's better than nothing, by about four layers of insulation.

OutfitHelmet02.strDesc: The counterpart to the Pathfinder pressure suit. The helmet attaches at the neck with seals rated 'Acceptable' by at least one System standards organisation.

OutfitHelmet02Dmg.strDesc: Damaged Pathfinder pressure suit helmet. The helmet attaches at the neck with seals rated 'Acceptable' by at least one System standards organisation.

OutfitHelmet03.strDesc: It should go without saying that a hermetically sealed EVA suit is significantly less useful without its helmet. And yet, the ISSB reports that in 55 years of recorded space colonisation, 37 users have entered vacuum without their helmet, in all cases fatally.

OutfitHelmet03Dmg.strDesc: It should go without saying that a hermetically sealed EVA suit is significantly less useful without its helmet. And yet, the ISSB reports that in 55 years of recorded space colonisation, 37 users have entered vacuum without their helmet, in all cases fatally.

OutfitPS01.strDesc: A Pathfinder protective suit which will insulate the wearer from hard vacuum, and little else. Caution: air supply is limited to what is trapped inside once sealed, which is usually only a few minutes.

OutfitPS01Dmg.strDesc: A damaged Pathfinder protective suit which will insulate the wearer from hard vacuum, and little else. Caution: air supply is limited to what is trapped inside once sealed, which is usually only a few minutes.

OutfitSuit01.strDesc: Despite efforts to quash this trend by an alliance of fashion moguls, these brown coats just seem to keep cropping up.

OutfitSuit02.strDesc:
A loose fitting garment covering the whole body, also known as a boilersuit. Wearing one will protect your modesty and little else.

Yellow is sometimes associated with optimism and gaiety; in Xinhua it is the color of prestige. It is also associated with high-visibility maintenance work.

OutfitSuit03.strDesc:
A loose fitting garment covering the whole body, also known as a boilersuit. Wearing one will protect your modesty and little else.

Red is a bold colour, often associated with danger and fire, but also with celebrations and luck. Many spacers are phobic towards red due to a long-standing memetic tradition concerning new crew members.

OutfitSuit04.strDesc:
A loose fitting garment covering the whole body, also known as a boilersuit. Wearing one will protect your modesty and little else.

Green is synonymous with envy, but also fertility and health. It is not a creative color.

OutfitSuit05.strDesc:
A loose fitting garment covering the whole body, also known as a boilersuit. Wearing one will protect your modesty and little else.

Tan is a light brown color tone. Its most noteworthy element is its lack of noteworthiness.

OutfitSuit06.strDesc:
A loose fitting garment covering the whole body, also known as a boilersuit. Wearing one will protect your modesty and little else.

Gray is often situated at a midpoint between the Manichaean light and dark, black and white, a morally neutral or ambivalent color. Grey is unsuitable for a wedding, unless you attend planning to kill someone.

OutfitSuit07.strDesc:
A loose fitting garment covering the whole body, also known as a boilersuit. Wearing one will protect your modesty and little else.

Purple is an auspicious color...

PocketClipPoint01.strDesc: A loop for affixing items by snaplinks. Useful for easy access to tools or tethers.

PocketBreast01.strDesc: A breast pocket on jackets or coveralls.

PocketCoat01.strDesc: A coat pocket on jackets or coats.

PocketEVABatt01.strDesc: A battery compartment in a Bingham-12 EVA suit.

PocketEVACO201.strDesc: A CO2 filter compartment in a Bingham-12 EVA suit.

PocketEVAO201.strDesc: An O2 bottle compartment in a Bingham-12 EVA suit.

PocketHip01.strDesc: A hip pocket on pants or coveralls.

PocketCargo01.strDesc: A roomy pocket on cargo pants or bags.

PocketHoodie01.strDesc: A roomy pocket on hoodies or jackets.

PocketSmall01.strDesc: A small pocket on stretch pants.

Compartment.strDesc:
Any room or exterior space in the world counts as a Compartment, and each will have their own tracked gas pressures and temperatures.

Any Compartment with an opening to the exterior of the ship will gradually match the temperature and pressure outside.

DataFile.strDesc: A digital representation of data. Able to be moved between devices.

SysFire.strDesc:
Fire.

One of mankind's oldest, and most powerful, tools.

Generally, you don't want to see this sort of thing on a spacecraft.

ItmChargerBattEVADmgLoose.strNameFriendly: Battery Charging Station: Bingham-12 EVA (Loose, Damaged)

ItmChargerBattery04DmgLoose.strNameFriendly: Battery Charging Station: Weber Laser (Loose, Damaged)

ItmAmmo12Gauge.strDesc: A once ubiquitous type of workhorse ammunition on Old Earth, it still has many adherents in deep space. It fires tiny pellets in a spread, maximizing chances of hitting and wounding a moving target.

ItmAmmo38.strDesc: Rare, Old Earth ammunition rounds once known for low recoil, accuracy, and Wild West gunslingers. Firing one in space is likely to end in rapid unplanned decompression.

ItmAmmo45.strDesc: A powerful Old Earth ammunition known for stopping power and robust recoil, more than ready to breach bodies and bulkheads.

ItmAmmo556.strDesc: A rifle cartridge inherited from Old Earth NATO weapons, this type of ammunition is fairly uncommon outside of military usage in space.

ItmAmmo9mm.strDesc: Once-common Old Earth ammunition that can still wreck a pressurized compartment even though smaller in size and firing energy than other Old Earth cartridges.

ItmAmmoHullsafe.strDesc: 9mm anti-personnel ammunition made with hollowgel technology that disperses silica gel beads on impact to minimize risk of hull decompression.

ItmAmmoPowerCell01.strDesc: A power pack for high-tech energy weapons.

ItmWeaponBaseballBat01.strDesc: A classic pick-up weapon from an Old Earth pasttime, usually made of aluminum or fiberglass.

ItmWeaponBaseballBat02.strDesc: A rare wooden version of the classic pick-up weapon from an Old Earth pasttime, with a faded signature and re-wrapped grip.

ItmWeaponCrossbow01.strDesc: A compound crossbow that propels sharpened bolts surprisingly well in micro-gravity. This bowed version is a modern interpretation of medieval designs with a rear reloading winch.

ItmWeaponCrossbow02.strDesc: A limbless crossbow that propels sharpened bolts surprisingly well in micro-gravity. This design is more compact than classic bowed versions, but still requires a removable winch to reload.

ItmWeaponCutlass01.strDesc: This age-of-sail deck weapon may seem anachronistic, but in the right hands, the short, curved blade can be effective against unarmored targets in tight spaces.

ItmWeaponGoat01.strDesc: A remarkable weapon formed from the skull and spine of a massive goat-human hybrid, barbaric to some, effective nonetheless. It allows both piercing and slashing through most protective wear.

ItmWeaponKatana01.strDesc: A long, curved sword with a 70cm single-edged blade and braided, one- or two-handed grip. Designed for balance, precision, and style, but sometimes long for tight spaces.

ItmWeaponKnife01.strDesc: A 30.5cm classic combat knife made of carbon steel with leather-ringed handle and partially serrated blade.

ItmWeaponKnuckles01.strDesc: Brass knuckles for discreetly adding heft and crack to your punches.

ItmWeaponMachete01.strDesc: An urban machete with a 46cm tempered steel blade and textured, synthetic grip. Designed for chopping and hacking through obstacles.

ItmWeaponNightstick01.strDesc: A short, side-handle T-baton made of aluminum, fiberglass, or carbon composite. Various batons are often carried by enforcement officers as a defensive compliance tool.

ItmWeaponNightstick02.strDesc: A long, side-handle T-baton made of aluminum, fiberglass, or carbon composite. Tonfa-inspired nightsticks are often carried by enforcement officers as a defensive compliance tool.

ItmWeaponPistol01.strDesc: An Old Earth classic, single-action projectile handgun with wood-inlaid grip. This semi-automatic, recoil-operated pistol typically holds 8 rounds of .45 ACP ammunition.

ItmWeaponPistol02.strDesc: A polymer-frame relic of Old Earth, this lightweight semi-automatic handgun typically holds 17 rounds of 9mm ammunition in a detachable magazine.

ItmWeaponPistol03.strDesc: Even for Old Earth weapons, this K-frame revolver is old-fashioned, holding 6 rounds of .38 Special ammunition in a swing-out cylinder.

ItmWeaponPistol04.strDesc: A jury-rigged firearm improvised from spare or printed parts, slam guns like these are meant to hold together only long enough to fire one or two hefty Old Earth rounds built into the weapon itself.

ItmWeaponPistolStun01.strDesc: An electronic stun pistol meant to incapacitate theough pain and involuntary muscle contraction. Powered by disposable batteries.

ItmWeaponPistolEnergy01.strDesc: A common, light-weight, polymer-body sidearm popular with law enforcement and security outfits. Chambers a 9mm cartridge.

ItmWeaponPocketKnife01.strDesc: A small foldable knife that fits in your pocket.

ItmWeaponRifle01.strDesc: An automatic, projectile combat rifle with lightweight stock, and capacity for 30 rounds of 5.8 mm ammunition. Highly dangerous in pressurized space structures. Developed by Xinhua military for fielding against personnel in armored EVAs.

ItmWeaponShiv01.strDesc: An ad hoc blade made of sharpened metal or glass wrapped in cloth, cord, or other similar materials to protect the gripping hand.

ItmWeaponShockProd01.strDesc: A stungun designed to deliver incapacitating shock through physical contact with an electrical arc between two conductive prongs. Powered by disposable batteries.

ItmWeaponShotgun01.strDesc:
An Old Earth pump action projectile shotgun, usually with a 6-shell magazine tube. Brutal against bodies at close range. Not advised for use in pressurized space structures.

Shotshell has added perks of doing less damage to sealed hull at any distance, and being less easily traced via forensic ballistics.

ItmWeaponSpear01.strDesc: A spear with a sharp steel tip on a meter-long haft.

ItmAmmo12GaugeHG.strDesc: A "less lethal" variant of the usual shotgun round, designed for crowd control in pressurized cabins. It uses hollowgel technology that disperses silica gel beads on impact to minimize risk of hull decompression.

ItmAmmo556HG.strDesc: A "less lethal" variant of the traditional 5.56mm cartridge, typically found in civilian law enforcement and navies. It uses hollowgel technology that disperses silica gel beads on impact to minimize risk of hull decompression.

ItmAmmo58.strDesc: A bottlenecked rifle cartridge developed by the Xinhua military for use by state forces.

ItmWeaponRifle02.strDesc: A Titan-made, high-tech boarding carbine chambered for 5.56mm rounds. Can be loaded with HG rounds for "safer" use in pressurized compartments.

ItmWeaponShotgun02.strDesc:
A light-weight, polymer-body shotgun, with extended ammo chamber.

Less common than its pistol or rifle siblings, this long gun is nevertheless popular with shooters more concerned with hitting targets than avoiding collateral damage.

ItmDocumentMeatPackaging.strDesc: Empty industrial packaging for a messy meat product. Bits of protein and blood remain inside, while old-fashioned Brave New World, LLC corporate marketing adorns the outside.

ItmMeat01.strDesc: An immovably large mass of raw, striated meat. It almost appears to be pulsating.

ItmMeat01Loose.strDesc: A handful of raw, striated meat.

ItmMeat01Eye.strDesc: An immovably large mass of raw, striated meat. Something round and glossy seems to be moving within.

ItmMineral01.strDesc: Meteoric Iron: A common iron-nickel alloy with a whitish crystalline structure, and the telltale reddish hue of iron oxide.

ItmMineral04.strDesc: Silicates form a wide variety of crystalline minerals common in asteroids, composed of silicon and oxygen bonded with various metals (often Fe or Al).

ItmMineral05.strDesc: Platinum. The rock that launched a thousand ships. Still draws a hefty price at the commodity exchange.

ItmMineral07.strDesc: Palladium. The second-hand member of the Platinum Group Metals (PGMs) much coveted by asteroid miners.

ItmMineral08.strDesc: Cobalt. A vibrant blue mineral that turns red when hydrated. Demanded in numerous industrial applications.

ItmMineral09.strDesc: Gold. Shiny, soft. Intoxicant of Old Earth civilizations. Still treasured for nostalgia, finery, and some fusion reactor fuels.

ItmMineral10.strDesc: Wolfram. A remarkably dense, robust metal with a high melting point. Suitable for a wide range of applications in industry, electronics, and weapons.

ItmMineral11.strDesc: Hydrates: A class of assorted hydrous minerals and compounds made of elements bonded with water or its component parts. Valuable for potential processing into liquid water.

"Smoke a rose."

ItmHygieneWipes01.strDesc:
A personal hygiene pack, a standard consumable kit with items for cleanliness and grooming on the float.

Along with general-use wet wipes, kit contents typically include soap, shaving supplies, deodorant, and the packaging passingly works as a single-use comb/hairbrush. Luxe kits may also include dental floss, lip balm, skin cream, nail clippers, sleep mask, and ear plugs.

Spacers often refill from preferred or affordable brands.

ItmMineral79.strDesc: While not a true opal, its unique visual properties are similar enough to opal's play-of-color to have garnered it the name 'void opal.' It has only been found in space, and is rarely seen on any commodities market, fueling speculation and conspiracies by many.

ItmDocument01_PLOT_Ceres_Ben_Notebook.strDesc: A graphed ledger penned in a neat hand. Names, dates, and a final column, unlabeled at the top, but with entries behind each name. John Wayne (GalCon) Francisco Ortega (Xinhua) Han Xiaoli (GalCon Double) Lawrence Masterson (GalCon) Pan Tao (GalCon) Flipping to the very back page of the notebook, you find two additional lines cw GalGon: Q: Where is true West? A: Follow the evening redness. cw Xinhua: Q: Have you ever grown nightshades? A: Only in borrowed soil.
